defect: logical exclusivity depends on an absent clock-select protocol
rationale: The timing exception assumes the clock choices are exclusive operating modes; RTL permits dynamic selection, and no environment contract establishes whether selection occurs only with stopped clocks.
author: gpt-6.1-sol
